content: We find in ourselves the labyrinth of which the world is the outer wall.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: The vast outer cosmos with all its galaxies is mirrored in the unfathomable depths of human consciousness. Exploring the inner world is the supreme adventure.
practicalInsight: Spend time journaling or meditating on your inner motives and emotional landscape today.
reflectionPrompt: What unexplored chamber of your own inner labyrinth needs understanding and light?
